_note: Run mechanics -- how a batch actually executes, independent of which league/decks. checkpoint_opponent_rate is the one field expected to be overridden per-invocation on purpose (e.g. a sub-league's planned 0.0 -> 0.20 switch at ~10k games/deck) rather than edited here. games_per_iteration, the PPO batch-size ramp (batch_size_start/cap/steps), and max_batch_size (league_*.json) used to live here too -- removed 2026-07-31: games_per_iteration is now always derived as max(1, n_workers) (one game per worker; see run_league.py main()'s own comment for the benchmark that grounded it), the PPO ramp is hardcoded in rl.train.batch_size_for_iteration (nobody had ever overridden it), and max_batch_size's safety role is now covered by the escalation loop (webapp / the /train skill) health-checking between every batch.
_league_note: ROLE SWAP + RENAME (2026-08-05): 4_deck_subleague_test trained to ~55,000 games/deck under PFSP for its last ~45,000 games but plateaued flat around 46-48% vs its gauntlet twin the whole stretch (see SWAP_EXPERIMENT.md at the repo root for the full writeup, since deleted -- this note is the surviving record) -- its first ~10,000 games predate PFSP entirely, hypothesized as the cause. The OTHER population (PFSP from game 1, previously named 4_deck_subleague_gauntlet) took over as the actively-trained population instead; the two checkpoint directories were then RENAMED to match their current roles, so this config's own league_name/gauntlet_league_name fields below did not need to change -- 4_deck_subleague_test is now (and going forward) whichever population is actively training, 4_deck_subleague_gauntlet is the frozen reference. See training_configs/run_gauntlet.json for why it's retired rather than reused.
_restart_note: COMPREHENSIVE RESTART (2026-08-06, see TRAINING_IMPROVEMENT_OPTIONS.md at repo root for the full audit): the PFSP-timing fix above did NOT resolve the underlying pattern -- the swapped-in, PFSP-from-game-1 population (retrained from scratch after an unrelated 2026-08 tokenization change) itself rose to 61% vs its gauntlet twin at session 14 (24,579 games/deck) then regressed to 26-36% by session 19, a rise-then-regress cycle, not a flat plateau. Root causes identified: a hard 1,600-game opponent-memory ceiling (fixed here, see rl/league.py's DEFAULT_MAX_SNAPSHOTS_PER_DECK), PFSP over-concentrating on the one matchup (mono_red_rally) three of four decks structurally cannot win (fixed here, see rl/league.py's PFSP_POWER), PPO exploration entropy collapsing to a floor by session ~9 and never recovering (fixed in rl/ppo.py -- entropy schedule + KL early stopping), and checkpoint_opponent_rate=0.5 adding non-stationarity on top of an already-shallow window (lowered here to 0.15, pending the deeper window actually making checkpoint diversity meaningful again). checkpoint_opponent_rate was 0.5 for every session of the population this config now supersedes. Both checkpoint trees (4_deck_subleague_test AND the frozen shared_stack_frozen.pt/pretrain_shared_stack.pt) were wiped and are being fully retrained under all of the above at once, plus a substantially larger pretrain budget before the next freeze.
_gauntlet_disabled_note: gauntlet_league_name was UNSET 2026-08-07 then RE-SET the same day: 4_deck_subleague_gauntlet was NOT retrained during the 2026-08-06 restart above, and _run_eval_vs_gauntlet's own docstring precondition ('two runs trained from the SAME frozen shared stack') was violated -- rl/league_runner.py:197,443,633 wires gauntlet's saved per-deck weights onto a DeckNetwork built on whatever stack the CALLING population currently uses, and gauntlet's weights were trained against the OLD frozen stack, deleted during the restart. Investigated whether that old stack was recoverable (git history) -- confirmed it wasn't: the last git-committed copy (commit 9533bff) was itself the 2026-08-05 wipe that wrote gauntlet's live.pt to zero bytes, so the actual stack gauntlet's 9,999 games were trained against only ever lived on local disk and was never committed again after that point. Every vs_gauntlet number collected 2026-08-06/07 (sessions 0-14, cumulative 0-24,579 games/deck) was confounded by the mismatch and shouldn't be trusted. Fix: checkpoints/4_deck_subleague_gauntlet wiped and being regrown as a genuine twin from the CURRENT frozen stack (see training_configs/run_gauntlet_twin.json) -- gauntlet_league_name here is safe to leave set throughout (the check is already a documented no-op until a deck has a real live.pt, per _run_eval_vs_gauntlet's own docstring), so it will silently start reporting real numbers again once the twin has trained. vs_history and the PPO entropy/approx_kl/epochs_run diagnostics remained trustworthy throughout since neither ever depended on gauntlet.
